candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll Experience for Path Selection
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection step into a story-driven scroll layout where user choices dynamically update visual mascot character previews.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off; a story scroll layout increases engagement and decision speed.

choose_path.headline: Begin Your Desktop Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Choose whether to pick a classic pre-made pet or generate your own unique companion.

candidates.score_note: Redesigning choose_path targets a 23.8% drop, but lacks support email backing and requires significant layout work.

candidates.title: Custom Pet AI Generation Progress Visualizer
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated preview screen right after custom photo upload to show visual progress during photo processing.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a high drop-off rate (31.1%) and users reported custom pet creation stalling or looking incorrect.

candidates.title: Move Sign In Before Certificate Finalization
candidates.change: Place sign-in immediately after pick_friend/upload_photos and before adoption_certificate so accounts are created before generating official pet records.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in later, and linking account before adoption certificate locks in pet data.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in before certificate finalization is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
